context.task: Locate and open the overdue task

scope: Initial work-queue composition at two widths and activation of the overdue task only; other controls are mocked.
label: Modern SaaS minimalism preference fit
weightProvenance: User-requested preference; weights and anchors authored for this skill, not empirically validated.

task.reason: Only the scoped overdue-row activation was probed; programmatic focus plus Enter opened the matching task. Discovery by users was not tested.

legibility.reason: Rendered appearance inspected; complete contrast/accessibility checks were not run.
evidence: No complete contrast or accessibility assessment supplied

interaction.reason: Task-row Enter activation and detail focus passed; navigation, toolbar and New task are nonfunctional mock controls, so this is not an approved working app.

adaptation.reason: Two widths have no root overflow; phone hides owner/due/sidebar and long content was not stress-tested. Full information availability remains unverified.

breakdown.label: Quiet hierarchy
breakdown.anchor: Content leads; navigation recedes; action emphasis follows task importance.
breakdown.reason: Content heading leads the neutral app frame; toolbar and sidebar recede.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Keep content priority; prevent the mobile New task label from wrapping awkwardly.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

breakdown.label: Restrained surfaces
breakdown.anchor: Flat content planes and purposeful boundaries; elevation identifies overlays.
breakdown.reason: A flat list uses thin row dividers and a single sidebar boundary without raised row cards.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Keep the flat list; test whether all row separators remain useful with longer records.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

breakdown.label: Typography-led composition
breakdown.anchor: Compact readable sans-led UI, distinct roles, intentional weight and number alignment.
breakdown.reason: 24px page heading and compact labels create stable app roles; mobile New task wraps onto two lines.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Give the header action sufficient intrinsic width or reflow it below the heading.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

breakdown.label: Useful density and rhythm
breakdown.anchor: Efficient rows/groups, clear internal versus external spacing, breathing room at transitions.
breakdown.reason: Four task rows fit the initial viewport at both sizes; status remains beside identity.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Keep comparable fields aligned; inspect a longer task title before tightening row space.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

breakdown.label: Precise component language
breakdown.anchor: Related control geometry, restrained radii and crisp icons; explicit labels where needed.
breakdown.reason: Controls share restrained radii and strokes; title/status columns align.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Retain related control geometry; refine the header action layout on phone.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

breakdown.label: Purposeful color
breakdown.anchor: Neutral or low-chroma working surfaces; accents identify action, selection, data or status.
breakdown.reason: Warm low-chroma planes and a brown primary action retain restrained hierarchy; Overdue still has a distinct red label.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Keep warm brand color; verify semantic contrast independently rather than replacing it with cool gray.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

breakdown.label: Product-specific restraint
breakdown.anchor: Restrained brand details, deliberate neutrality or domain-specific content ground the design in its product.
breakdown.reason: A serif wordmark and warm palette add a modest signature while the app content remains sans-led and direct.
breakdown.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
breakdown.nextChange: Preserve the restrained signature; no extra logo effects are needed.
breakdown.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.
